arms.description: Current JSON-schema tool dispatch: kernel tools exposed as JSON tool schemas, one dispatch per call (baseline arm).
PTC/RLM arm: the same kernel tools exposed as callable functions inside a persistent interpreter (REPL), per Prime Agent's programmatic tool calling.

promotionCriterion.adopt: repl-ptc shows >=20% reduction in tokensPerTask AND non-inferior successRate (one-sided alpha=0.05)
